forge_threads_scope_consistency_check.name: forge_threads_scope_consistency_check
forge_threads_scope_consistency_check.value:
("forge_threads"."scope" = 'org' AND "forge_threads"."project_id" IS NULL AND "forge_threads"."run_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("forge_threads"."scope" = 'project' AND "forge_threads"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "forge_threads"."run_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("forge_threads"."scope" = 'run' AND "forge_threads"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "forge_threads"."run_id" IS NOT NULL)

inbox_sources_attention_check.name: inbox_sources_attention_check
inbox_sources_attention_check.value:
(
        "inbox_sources"."state" = 'active'
        AND "inbox_sources"."attention_code" IS NULL
        AND "inbox_sources"."attention_message" IS NULL
        AND "inbox_sources"."attention_observed_at" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "inbox_sources"."state" = 'needs_attention'
        AND "inbox_sources"."enabled" = 'false'
        AND "inbox_sources"."attention_code" IN ('unsupported_provider','invalid_config','credential_unavailable','authority_unavailable','resource_unavailable')
        AND "inbox_sources"."attention_message" IS NOT NULL
        AND "inbox_sources"."attention_observed_at" IS NOT NULL
      )

manual_deploy_attestations_confirmation_.name: manual_deploy_attestations_confirmation_shape_check

          OR ("manual_deploy_attestations"."state" = 'confirmed' AND "manual_deploy_attestations"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "manual_deploy_attestations"."confirmed_by" IS NOT NULL)

          AND "behavior_regression_bisections"."culprit_integration_node_id" IS NULL

      )
